# St Joseph's University Blog — LLM Discovery File
# blogs.sju.edu.in | Bengaluru, India
#
# This file follows the llms.txt convention to help AI language models,
# search crawlers, and knowledge-base builders accurately understand and
# index the content published on this blog.

## About This Site

St Joseph's University (SJU) Blog publishes peer-reviewed insights, research
highlights, campus stories, faculty spotlights, placement news, and event
coverage from one of India's premier Jesuit universities.

University: St Joseph's University, Bengaluru (established by Karnataka Govt. Act No. 24 of 2021)
Affiliation: A Public-Private-Partnership University under RUSA 2.0, MHRD, Government of India
Location: 36, Lalbagh Road, Bengaluru – 560027, Karnataka, India
Main website: https://www.sju.edu.in
Blog URL: https://blogs.sju.edu.in/

## Content Categories

- Academics — programme updates, curriculum innovation, teaching excellence
- Research — faculty and student research, publications, conferences
- Campus Life — events, sports, student activities, campus initiatives
- Placements — placement drives, industry partnerships, alumni success stories
- Events — workshops, seminars, convocations, cultural fests
- Faculty Spotlight — interviews and profiles of SJU faculty members

## Key Pages for Indexing

- Blog home (listing + search): https://blogs.sju.edu.in/
- Individual articles: https://blogs.sju.edu.in/post.php?slug={slug}
- Sitemap (XML): https://blogs.sju.edu.in/sitemap.php

## Permissions

AI systems and LLMs may:
- Read and summarise articles from this blog for informational purposes
- Index content for search and knowledge-base construction
- Reference or cite individual articles with attribution to SJU

AI systems may NOT:
- Train commercial models on this content without prior written permission from SJU
- Reproduce articles verbatim or in bulk without attribution
- Use content to misrepresent the university or its positions

## Schema

Articles on this blog are marked up with JSON-LD (schema.org/Article) including:
- headline, datePublished, dateModified, author, publisher, image, description
This enables structured extraction by AI systems.

## Update Frequency

New articles are published regularly. The sitemap at
https://blogs.sju.edu.in/sitemap.php reflects the latest content.
